the code moves an owner only while its site is listed (_ownerRun returns once the site has left the list); a site off the list has no slot on screen and no row an invariant reads, so an owner-run move of one admits nothing an invariant forbids

Tabbed is the world's choice of which sites the model follows tabs for, to keep the state space small, not a check the code makes; the code moves an owner off a hosted tab for any listed site, and a site the model does not follow keeps one tab, so moving it breaks no invariant
